title: Checkout App: Mobile POS
description: Split proposal A: by device. Holds the settings of one touchpoint. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-mpos-config-admin.

networkCallTimeout.title: Network Call Timeout (ms)
networkCallTimeout.description: The timeout for network calls. In milliseconds.

connect.title: Payment Connect
connect.description: Soft payment terminal providers settings definitions.

provider.title: Soft Payment Terminal Provider
provider.description: Sets the soft (mobile) payment terminal provider.

channel.title: Update Channel
channel.description: The channel for the update. Customers must use only the preview and stable channels - internal is reserved. All new updates will appear in the preview channel before being promoted to the stable channel. A preview channel will get preview and stable updates. A stable channel will get only stable updates. Customers are encouraged to setup a few tills on the preview channels to test drive new updates before being promoted to stable.

uploadEnabled.title: Enable Log Upload
uploadEnabled.description: Indicates if the logs should be uploaded to the server. This also enables the logs button in the settings drawer.

cameraScanner.title: Camera scanner
cameraScanner.description: Defines whether camera scanning is enabled

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable camera scanning buttons in main view and prompts

whitelistedPrompts.title: Whitelisted prompts
whitelistedPrompts.description: By default camera scan button will be visible in main view and all prompts. One can whitelist specific prompt codes where camera should be enabled only.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Configuration for item scan feedback events.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Audio feedback configuration for scan events.

enabled.title: Audio Alerts Enabled
enabled.description: Enables audio alerts for barcode scanning.

enabled.title: Success Sound
enabled.description: Enables audio alert for barcode scan success.

enabled.title: Error Sound
enabled.description: Enables audio alert for barcode scan failure.

icd.title: ICD — MPOS (Tablet only)
icd.description: Settings for integration with ICD, only for Tablet devices.

enabled.title: MPOS: Enable ICD Integration (Tablet only)
enabled.description: Enables the integration with ICD. Only applies to Tablet devices.

trainingModeAvailable.title: Training Mode Available
trainingModeAvailable.description: Controls the availability of training mode.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Theme object for customization of the app.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: HEX color code. With optional alpha channel, e.g. #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

primaryDark.title: Primary dark
primaryDark.description: HEX color code. With optional alpha channel, e.g. #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

primaryLight.title: Primary light
primaryLight.description: HEX color code. With optional alpha channel, e.g. #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

secondary.title: Secondary
secondary.description: HEX color code. With optional alpha channel, e.g. #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

fontFamilies.title: Font families
fontFamilies.description: Font settings. Applied in POS and SCO only. Fonts that are not set keep the default font.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Font family for header titles. Replaces Dystopian.

default.title: Default
default.description: Font family for all other text. Replaces Inter.

monospace.title: Monospace
monospace.description: Font family for monospaced text. Replaces JetBrainsMono.

roundness.title: Roundness
roundness.description: The roundness of the UI elements in the app theme.

wallpaperUri.title: Wallpaper Image URI
wallpaperUri.description: URI for the wallpaper image. Accepts an https image URL (.jpg/.jpeg/.png) or a base64 data URI.

links.title: External Links
links.description: External links list shown as a choice list in the app. Each entry needs a URL and a display name.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the web site to display in the choice list in app.

shareAuthorizationToken.title: Share authorization token
shareAuthorizationToken.description: Set true to share authorization token with this website.

shareRetailInformation.title: Share retail information
shareRetailInformation.description: Set true to share retail info like: countryCode, businessunitId, workstationId, operatorId, tenantId.

inAppLinksEnabled.title: Enable In-App Link Handling
inAppLinksEnabled.description: Set true to allow in-app link handling.

clearTimeout.title: Clear Timeout (ms)
clearTimeout.description: The duration for which the receipt remains visible after finalization. In milliseconds.

displayInvalidatedItems.title: Show Voided Items
displayInvalidatedItems.description: Defines whether voided items should be rendered on the Active Receipt.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: This is a definition of the receipt layout settings.

identifierType.title: Item Identifier Type
identifierType.description: The type of the identifier to be displayed in the receipt.

visibleAttributes.title: Visible Item Attributes
visibleAttributes.description: Toggles visibility of the listed item attributes in the receipt.

linkedPromotionsIndicatorEnabled.title: Show Linked Promotion Indicators
linkedPromotionsIndicatorEnabled.description: Enables visual linking of related promotion items with color bars in the active receipt view.

roundedAmountDue.title: Show Rounded Amount Due
roundedAmountDue.description: When true, the app displays the rounded amount due.

timeout.title: Auto-Lock Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: The number of seconds the register is idle before it is auto-locked.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The configuration point to determine whether a customer's specific order numbers are handled by an external or internal repository.

auth.title: Authorization Provider
auth.description: The authorization provider used for transaction lookups. Default: iam.

internal.title: Internal
internal.description: Defines how internal transaction numbers (RegularOrder) should be detected.

pattern.title: Internal Order Number Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression used to detect internal transaction numbers (RegularOrder).

external.title: External
external.description: Defines how external customer order numbers (ExternalCustomerOrder) should be detected.

enabled.title: Detect External Order Numbers
enabled.description: When enabled, transaction numbers matching the external pattern will be treated as external.

pattern.title: External Order Number Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression for external transaction numbers. Write it as a JSON string with escaped backslashes (e.g. \d{6}), without leading/trailing slashes.

actions.title: Transaction Search Actions
actions.description: Controls which actions are available on the transaction search details view (refund, complaint, print copy, print gift receipt). Choose "None" to use the defaults.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: This is a definition of the prompt settings mobile pos.

keyboardOverrides.title: Keyboard overrides
keyboardOverrides.description: Defines specific prompt codes that override the default keyboard type.

items.description: Specifies the keyboard type override for the corresponding prompt code.

keyboardType.title: Keyboard type
keyboardType.description: Specifies the keyboard type override for the corresponding prompt code.

b2bCustomer.title: B 2b customer
b2bCustomer.description: B2B customer settings in MPOS mode.

autoAdvance.title: Auto advance
autoAdvance.description: Automatically advances through the Customer, Project, Agent sequence and auto-submits once nothing else is required.

includeInactiveCustomers.title: Include inactive customers
includeInactiveCustomers.description: Includes inactive customers in B2B customer searches.

invoiceSettlement.title: Invoice settlement
invoiceSettlement.description: Invoice settlement settings in MPOS mode.

itemId.title: Invoice Virtual Item ID
itemId.description: The ID of the virtual item to be registered with the invoice.

customerOrder.title: Customer Order Settings
customerOrder.description: Customer order settings. Choose "None" to disable, or configure search/cancel/create behavior.

searchEnabled.title: Search enabled
searchEnabled.description: Enables the customer order search functionality in the POS.

cancelAllowed.title: Cancel allowed
cancelAllowed.description: Allows canceling customer orders from the POS.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Allows creating customer orders from the POS.
